messages.author: 7b9434fc7a4a1a0e
messages.subject: R crashing repeatedly
parts:
Hi,

Over the past couple of weeks, R has repeatedly crashed for me. It has crashed using different scripts, on different datasets, on three different Windows machines, using version 3.2.1 and 3.2.2, operating within rstudio or rgui.

Unfortunately, exactly when/where it crashes tends to vary. It will sometimes run a file fine, and sometime crash. Once it starts crashing, it won't let me run that script without crashing, although I can sometimes (but not always) run the script line by line without failure. 

I'm not sure if this an an R thing or a dplyr thing, as I am most often using both at the same time. 

Here are some examples of code that has crashed R today:

sb_select <- sb_select %>%
  mutate(
    GradeLevel = extract_numeric(Grade_GradeLevelName),
    GradeLevel = ifelse(Grade_GradeLevelName == "Pre - Kindergarten", 14, GradeLevel),
    GradeLevel = ifelse(Grade_GradeLevelName == "Kindergarten" |  Grade_GradeLevelName == "Full Time Kindergarten", 0, GradeLevel),
    GradeLevel = GradeLevel + 1
  )
  
---

all_ros <- bind_rows(binders)

---

sb_select <- sb_select %>%
  mutate(`Entry Date` = as.Date(StartDate, "%m/%d/%Y"),
         `Exit Date` = as.Date(EndDate, "%m/%d/%Y"),
         `Birth Date` = as.Date(`Birth Date`, "%m/%d/%Y"),
         `Section ID` = as.character(SystemSectionID)
  ) %>%
  filter(`Entry Date` >= as.Date("8/1/2015", "%m/%d/%Y")) 

---

These examples all work with the same dataset, which reliably causes failure, but has confidential info.

Any advice on where to start troubleshooting?  Do I need to prepare a clean version of a dataset and code that cause failure? This has really brought my work to a halt. 

Best,
Ryan


--
